set.body:
Build the executable comparison boundary without contaminating foundation dependencies.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-432-01: The unpublished runner reads and writes fixtures through image4s-nifti and invokes the canonical reframe4s-motion public pipeline.
AC-432-02: Pinned AFNI 3dvolreg, nifreeze, and FSL MCFLIRT adapters capture corrected images, transforms, available internal stage times, explicit unavailable-stage provenance, stdout, stderr, tool metadata, process-tree resource measurements, materialized bytes, and failures in one versioned result schema. Optional comparators use the same schema.
AC-432-03: Independent convention fixtures prove every adapter input-to-reference or reference-to-input conversion against physical landmark mappings on nontrivial complete affines.
AC-432-04: The estimation court applies all recovered transforms through the same benchmark-only image4s-reference resampler outside its timing boundary. The native court separately evaluates each declared production pipeline and records every final interpolation, boundary, mask, reference, and resampling opportunity.
AC-432-05: All methods receive equivalent declared inputs and allocated-core ceilings; registered reference, mask, and effective-worker differences remain explicit rather than normalized after results are known.
AC-432-06: The runner supports paired seeded balanced repeated execution, one-core and four-core ceilings, isolated outputs, one observable process boundary for every method, and method-internal stage splits only where instrumentation exists.
AC-432-07: It emits deterministic raw per-frame and per-run results plus plan-validated aggregate JSON and CSV, checksums, complete failure rows, and no silent skips.
AC-432-08: A hermetic smoke court runs in ordinary CI without external proprietary data; full locked courts are separately scheduled or manually dispatched.
